evidence.why: All user-controlled fields (name, email, company, avatarUrl) are HTML-entity escaped before interpolation, neutralising tag/attribute breakout, equivalent to default escaping.

controls_present: manual HTML entity escaping of interpolated values
CR/LF and line-separator stripping before interpolation
zod schema validation of input shape
attempted DOMPurify sanitisation pass with ALLOWED_TAGS/ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS as defense-in-depth
other_classes_observed: named import `{ sanitize } from 'dompurify'` is not a valid export of the dompurify package, so the second sanitisation layer likely throws and silently falls back to a weak regex filter
zod .url() does not restrict scheme, allowing non-http(s) schemes like javascript: to pass validation before sanitizeValue, though entity escaping blocks attribute breakout
